sections.title: Process of Joining Our Screen Network

cards.title: Step 1: Consultation
cards.description: Before we begin creating your Ad we'll take time to get to know your brand, messaging, and any important images you would like us to include.

cards.title: Step 2: Ad Creation
cards.description: Once we have gathered your assets, we'll get to work developing your ad. After we've completed your full-motion ad, we'll send it back to you for approval and refinement.

cards.title: Step 3: Campaign Launch
cards.description: After you've approved your ad, we'll deploy your ad across our network locations that are most relevant to your target audience.

cards.title: Step 4: Maintenance + Updates
cards.description: Throughout the lifetime of your contract, we'll be in regular contact to ensure that your ad is up-to-date and engaging to your audience.

faqs.question: What if I want a screen inside my location?
faqs.answer: Reach out to us to see if your business qualifies to join our network. We look for busy local businesses with good dwell times and customers who'd benefit from what other local businesses offer. Become a venue partner today, or view our current network locations to see where we're already established.

faqs.question: What if I already have content for my campaigns for the year?
faqs.answer: Even better! We can create content for the entire year matching your seasonal campaigns. When you're ready to launch, just give us the word, and we'll start airing the pre-made ad across our network locations.

faqs.question: What if I need to run an ad for only a short time, like for an event?
faqs.answer: Not a problem, we deal with events and promotions all the time. Just contact us and we can come up with an ad production plan that will align with your campaign needs.
